goalTextEn: Can handle basic phone conversations at work.
goalTextKr: 기본적인 전화 응대를 할 수 있다.

introduce.goalEn: Can handle basic phone conversations at work.
introduce.goalKr: 기본적인 전화 응대를 할 수 있다.
introduce.situationEn: A morning of phone calls: answer, transfer, take messages, call back.
introduce.situationKr: 바쁜 아침 전화 상황: 받기, 연결하기, 메시지 받기, 다시 전화하기.

tutorNotes.text: "Today, we will practice can handle basic phone conversations at work.."
Read the lesson goal aloud. Ask the student to repeat.
"Is it clear?"
Read the situation. Check the student understands.
"Let's go to the next part."
On the phone, clarity is more important than speed.

vocabulary.definition: to connect a call to another person

pronunciation.instruction: Review: clear phone voice and polite intonation.
pronunciation.instructionKr: 복습: 또박또박한 전화 목소리와 정중한 억양을 연습합시다.

words.en: May I speak to Mr. Lee?

tutorNotes.text: "Let's learn the key phone and email phrases."
Read each pattern aloud. Ask the student to repeat.
Teach vocabulary with short examples.
"Now, let's practice pronunciation."
Model polite tone and clear speech.

understand.instruction: Fill in the blanks with the correct pattern. Then practice the pattern drills.
understand.instructionKr: 빈칸에 올바른 표현을 넣고, 패턴 드릴을 연습하세요.

patternDrills.label: Answer + transfer
patternDrills.template: This is ___ speaking. One moment, please. I will transfer you.

examples.en: This is Mina speaking. One moment, please. I will transfer you.

patternDrills.label: Take a message
patternDrills.template: Can I take a message? Please tell ___ that ___.

examples.en: Can I take a message? Please tell James that I called.
examples.kr: 메시지 남겨 드릴까요? 전화드렸다고 제임스에게 전해 주세요.

patternDrills.label: Callback
patternDrills.template: Can he call you back? I'll let ___ know.

examples.en: Can he call you back at 3? I'll let him know.

tutorNotes.text: Do the fill-in-the-blank first.
Run drills with substitutions.
Focus on correct pattern choice and clarity.

steps.title: Step 1 - Repeat After Me
steps.content:
1. Hello. This is Mina speaking.
2. May I speak to Mr. Lee?
3. One moment, please. Please hold on.
4. I will transfer you to extension 204.
5. Can I take a message?
6. I'll let him know.

tutorNotes.text: Read each line clearly and model phone voice.
Remind the student to slow down and articulate.

steps.title: Step 2 - Personalize It
steps.instructionEn: Complete the lines using your own context.
steps.content:
1. Hello. This is _______________ speaking.
2. May I speak to _______________?
3. One moment, please. Please hold on.
4. I will transfer you to extension _______________.
5. Can I take a message?
6. I'll let _______________ know.

tutorNotes.text: Have the student fill in first, then read aloud.
Use realistic names, departments, and times.

steps.title: Step 3 - Dialogue Practice
steps.instructionEn: Practice this dialogue with your tutor.

dialogue.en: Hello, may I speak to your manager?
Hello. This is Mina speaking. One moment, please.
He is in a meeting. Can I take a message?
Yes. Please tell him I will call back at 3.

tutorNotes.text: Do it once reading, then once naturally.
Keep phone responses short and clear.

steps.title: Step 4 - Free Speaking
steps.instructionEn: Speak freely using at least 5 sentences.
steps.content:
Include:
- Handle one transfer
- Handle one message
- Confirm one callback time
- Use polite phone voice
- Close the call

tutorNotes.text: "Try a realistic phone/email role-play."
Give feedback after the student finishes.

challenge.scenarioEn: Role-play a busy morning: 4 calls. Answer, transfer, take a message, and confirm callback details.
challenge.scenarioKr: 바쁜 아침 롤플레이: 4통의 전화를 처리합니다. 받기, 연결, 메시지, 회신 정보를 모두 처리하세요.

guideQuestions.text: Use at least three target patterns.
Take one message with details (name + time).

tutorNotes.text: "Challenge time. Keep your phone voice clear."
Success = clear intent + polite patterns + correct key details.

discussion.instructionEn: Choose one category and answer the questions.

categories.title: REAL CALLS
questions: What calls do you get at work?
Do you prefer phone or email?

categories.title: NEXT STEP
questions: What business English do you want next?
Do you want more email writing practice?
Do you want more phone role-plays?

tutorNotes.text: "Now, a short discussion."
Discuss for 3-5 minutes.
